### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**4** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **18** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 73432299c0649af2318d137522d55cf444b3a869` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `817b5361916dca2cdc5b47ea54d67527598c3690` — the merge of head `2e76ecfc31ce49425c9f09f6ee39b73386a474d1` into base `73432299c0649af2318d137522d55cf444b3a869`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 817b5361916dca2cdc5b47ea54d67527598c3690 && git checkout 817b5361916dca2cdc5b47ea54d67527598c3690
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 73432299c0649af2318d137522d55cf444b3a869 2e76ecfc31ce49425c9f09f6ee39b73386a474d1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 73432299c0649af2318d137522d55cf444b3a869 && git merge --no-ff 2e76ecfc31ce49425c9f09f6ee39b73386a474d1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 73432299c0649af2318d137522d55cf444b3a869
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `49bf2c2d1d`
Local-runs: none

Scope: the net diff against the merge base (7 files, +237/−14):
- `packages/objectql/src/duplicate-record-error.ts`, its five `engine.ts` call sites, the new `engine-duplicate-record-label-sentence.test.ts` and the changeset;
- the cross-lane pin in `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta-stored-legacy-organization.integration.test.ts`;
- the two text edits in `content/docs/protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`.

Read with them: `objectql`'s `index.ts` export of `DuplicateRecordError`; the card #24951 with the claim 6303746829, the dispatch 6303787413 and the seat's re-declaration 6305353681; the dev's `os-dev-report` 6305304249 and its fix-round report 6305377332 (read as claims); and the PR body.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The user-facing sentence names by label: right.**
  - All five engine doors that raise the refusal pass `this.getSchema(object)` to `envelopeUniqueViolation`: the single insert and its autonumber retry, the batch insert, update by id, and update by predicate.
  - `declaredLabels` reads the object's `label` and the conflicting field's `label`. Each must be a non-empty string, otherwise the API name is used.
  - The opening `Duplicate record refused on '` and the closing `No record was written.` are unchanged. The sentence still does not start with a SQL verb, so the importer's `sanitizeRowError` backstop leaves it alone.
- **`developerMessage` now opens with the API names** (`Duplicate record refused on object '…', field '…'.`); before, it named neither. That is the right place for them. On the REST data routes the wire `developerMessage` carries the engine's sentence, so it names the labels, while the body's `object` and `field` keys keep the API names. The changeset states both.
- **No code, status or outcome moves.** `DUPLICATE_RECORD` in the engine, `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` on every wire route, and 409 are as before.
- **The constructor: accepted.** `DuplicateRecordError` is exported from `objectql`'s index, and its constructor gains an optional fourth argument, a module-local `{ object?, field? }`. That is additive: three-argument callers get the API-name sentence as before. It adds no export or member. The labels must reach `super()`, so a pre-resolution would need the same seam.
- **The pins have teeth.** The 17 tests cover four doors × (labelled sentence, API-name fallback, field-less variant, `developerMessage` API names), plus one more. In the ablation, 13 go red and the 4 fallback pins stay green, as they describe the old behaviour. Every exact-sentence pin elsewhere uses an unlabelled fixture, so the fallback keeps it green.
- **The second producer** (`driver-sql`'s `refuseUpsertConflictOutsideWrittenOrganization`) keeps API names. It is reached by direct driver callers only, not by an engine write door. That is noted, and it meets no filing gate.

### ② Semver level

- `patch` for `@objectstack/objectql`: right for a text change with no accept set, code or status moving.
- **Fix round 1:** the claim's `Clause-②` parenthetical was the seat's and said "no developer message moves", which was inexact. It was re-declared in 6305353681. Head `49bf2c2d1d` carries the re-declared line in the changeset (line 7), and the seat patched the PR body to match. The dev declined to patch the body, rightly, under os-dev.md rule 3.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Cross-lane, `domain:cli`** (`meta-stored-legacy-organization.integration.test.ts`, test-only): the pin now matches the stable opening and `error.object === 'sys_metadata'`. Declared on #6024 at 6305367998.
- **Cross-lane, `domain:devx`** (the error-handling doc and the `qa_unique` checklist clause, text only): declared on #6023 at 6305373450.
- **The other deviations:** the worker restart (suites re-run to completion) and the model-free trailers are accepted.
- **Open questions:** all three taken as the dev settled them: keep the frame and substitute labels; no localized catalog entry now; the default label, not a per-locale one.
- **CI on `49bf2c2d1d`:** still running at this read. The `TypeScript Type Check` failure on the superseded head `697e25ef65` was the aggregator over two lanes cancelled by the new push, not a type error. The ACCEPT waits for green on this head.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24951-duplicate-message-labels`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`

**VERDICT: PASS**
